name: web-guards
description: The parsers the web guards read code with: acorn for JavaScript, parse5 for HTML (the same pin as claude.directives' check-paths.js; entities is parse5's only dependency, pinned too), and eslint-scope, ESLint's own scope analyzer, for what each name refers to. Installed by the web-guards composite from its own directory in the shared checkout; a project never copies it. Exact pins, and the lockfile beside it pins the whole graph.
